Label: GPU inference server with NVIDIA L4 cards, scaled to 1 kW
Status: variant: not the case's reference server; the reference house keeps the abstract 1 kW server of config/reference-house.json for scored figures
Description: One 'server' = 1 kW of electric load: one host (Dell R570 class, price and power as in cpu-server) plus as many 72 W L4 cards as fit in the remaining power (11.6, fractional like the case's 12.5 servers). A real build is rounded and may need a GPU-dense chassis; slot count per host is TODO(source).

UnitElectricKw.source: data/raw/market/hardware.csv hw-power-nvidia-l4-tdp: max TDP 72 W (high); board limit used as loaded power, measured inference draw TODO(source)

UnitPurchasePriceChf.source: data/raw/market/hardware.csv hw-cost-bechtle-pny-l4: CHF 2235 excl. VAT (low: search snippet, out of stock)

HostElectricKw.source: same estimate as config/hardware/cpu-server.json UnitElectricKw (Xeon 6507P TDP + memory); host draw under GPU load TODO(source)

HostPurchasePriceChf.source: data/raw/market/costs.csv cost-server-dell-r570 as lower bound for a GPU host; a GPU-dense 2U chassis starts at CHF 28,720 (cost-server-brentford-s240-from, configuration unverified)

ServerElectricKw.source: docs/case/challenge.md: rack-server reference (1 kW), used as normalisation

IdleElectricKw.source: TODO(source): idle draw of L4 cards and host not sourced (a reseller lists a 40 W configurable minimum per card, unverified)

HeatRecoveryShare.source: docs/case/challenge.md: 80 percent recoverable into water (assumes liquid cooling; L4 cards are passively air-cooled, TODO(source) water-block option)

LifetimeYears.source: data/raw/market/costs.csv lifetime-coreweave-technology-accounting (accounting life incl. GPU infrastructure, not physical life)

OpsChfPerServerYear.source: derived: 1 host x CHF 59 per server-month x 12 (data/raw/market/costs.csv cost-ops-smartsolution-server-basic); assumes one physical host per kW

TranscriptionAudioHoursPerServerHour.source: derived: 11.6313 cards x 40.4 audio h per GPU-hour (data/raw/market/hardware.csv hw-perf-e2e-l4-whisper-turbo-b4, low: vendor blog via snippet); larger model than cpu-server's whisper base

LlmTokensPerServerHour.source: docs/research/l4-throughput.md section 2 'Recommended (economics default)': 11.63 cards x 589.3 tokens/s (Qwen2.5-7B, vLLM, BF16, concurrency 64, vllm-serving-bench L1) x 3600 s = 24.7 M, rounded to 25 M; pessimistic reading, all tokens (input and output) counted alike; range 17 M (Bench360 vLLM) to 120 M (FP8, output reading); third-party, partly from search snippets, no measured L4 power, TODO(source) own vllm bench serve run

WebhostingSitesPerServer.source: TODO(source): GPUs add nothing to webhosting; host CPU only

SpotPriceChfPerServerHour.source: derived: 11.6313 x CHF 0.1914 per hour AWS g6.xlarge spot eu-central-2 (data/raw/market/compute-prices.csv cp-gpu-aws-g6-xlarge-euc2-spot, medium); one g6.xlarge = 1 L4 + 4 vCPU

OnDemandPriceChfPerServerHour.source: derived: 11.6313 x CHF 0.9116 per hour AWS g6.xlarge on-demand eu-central-2 (cp-gpu-aws-g6-xlarge-euc2-od, high)

HomeHostPriceChfPerServerHour.source: derived: 11.6313 x CHF 0.3697 per GPU-hour RunPod L4 community cloud (cp-mkt-runpod-l4-community, high); Infomaniak Swiss L4 from CHF 0.3053/h gives 3.55
